title: Weird Creatures- relax
content: Hello, Just a community update. If you notice any strange creatures like 2 legged horses or headless Ostriches or short gremlins or a red demon, relax, its not real. Itsboir shared subconscious processing unresolved anger. Please will you all forgive someone who hurt you recently. Or else your demons will fill up our world. It's not bad because they're not real, but it's a little jarring. If you don't want to forgive, then first get some catharsis and then let it go with a symbolic gesture by Nov 17. You can use any method you like. Any modality. As long as you do it please. Your heart must be light as a feather. We have provided catharsis visualisers.
